facts.rationale: Preserves the missing-return branch and downstream event guard omitted by the existing positive-resource claim.
facts.value: Does nothing without a held item. Otherwise requests a shot level from it_80291DAC with fixed input zero and passes the result to fn_800D84D4, without a local motion transition. The selector returns -1 for nonpositive resource; a selected affordable level zero returns zero, but positive resource alone does not guarantee that result. Attribute-dependent selection and an unaffordable level-zero fallthrough prevent treating the selector as a total loaded/empty binary mapping. The shared firing helper additionally requires its item and throw-event guards before projectile or empty-feedback effects.
